battle.name: 波希戰爭
battle.theater: 小亞細亞西岸與希臘本土
battle.brief: 公元前四九九年愛奧尼亞起義揭開戰端，前四九〇年米太亞德率一萬雅典重裝步兵在馬拉松平原封住波斯軍退路，開希臘方陣擊敗大軍之先例。卡面的重裝步兵正是此役的決定性裝備：八列縱深的方陣與相接的圓盾，讓列奧尼達的數百人擋住溫泉關的波斯大軍，也讓地米斯托克利的艦隊在薩拉米斯反敗為勝。

kit.name: 希臘重步兵
kit.history: 方陣的重心不是個人，是互相遮蔽。盾牌接在一起時，一支軍隊的正面比一個人結實。

countries: 波希戰爭是阿契美尼德波斯帝國與希臘城邦之間、前四九九年至前四四九年的一系列軍事衝突，交戰舞台從小亞細亞西岸的愛奧尼亞一路移到希臘本土、薩拉米斯海峽與埃及。波斯一方是行省體系的帝國：國王居蘇薩與波斯波利斯，以總督統轄各行省，軍隊由波斯本族、伊朗高原的米底人、薩卡人、巴克特里亞人，以及被徵發的屬國步兵、弓手、騎兵與戰車組成，另有常備的萬人不死軍。開戰的導火線是前四九九年米利都的阿里斯塔格拉斯煽動的愛奧尼亞起義，雅典與埃雷特里亞出兵焚毀波斯內陸首府薩第斯，起義則在前四九三年米利都陷落時被平定。希臘一方起初並非聯盟，而是各城邦各自應戰：雅典於前四九〇年的馬拉松以重裝步兵方陣擊敗波斯軍，前四八〇年溫泉關的希臘聯軍由斯巴達王列奧尼達率領並全滅，薩拉米斯海戰由雅典主導的艦隊取勝，前四七九年普拉提亞的野戰再由斯巴達將軍帕薩尼阿斯率聯軍獲勝。前四八一年科林斯會議建立的城邦同盟，是此後聯軍的組織形式。
countriesEn: The Persian Wars were a series of military clashes between the Achaemenid Persian Empire and the Greek city-states, running from 499 to 449 BC, and their stage moved in a single arc from the Ionian coast of Asia Minor across to the Greek mainland, the straits of Salamis and Egypt. On the Persian side stood an empire organised into satrapies: the king ruled from Susa and Persepolis, satraps governed the provinces, and the armies were drawn from the Persians themselves, the Medes of the Iranian plateau, the Saka and the Bactrians, together with levied contingents of subject infantry, archers, cavalry and chariots, and the standing Ten Thousand Immortals. The spark was the Ionian Revolt of 499 BC raised by Aristagoras of Miletus; Athens and Eretria came to the rebels' aid and burned Sardis, the Persian capital inland, and the revolt was crushed in 493 BC when Miletus fell. The Greek side was at first no alliance at all but a set of separate city-states each fighting on its own: at Marathon in 490 BC the hoplite phalanx of Athens broke a Persian army; at Thermopylae in 480 BC the Greek force led by the Spartan king Leonidas was destroyed to the last man; the Athenian-dominated fleet won at Salamis; and in the open field at Plataea in 479 BC a Greek coalition under Pausanias was victorious. The Hellenic League constituted at Corinth in 481 BC was the organisation that held the coalition together for the rest of the war.
people: 大流士一世是這場戰爭的策動者，他以薩第斯縱火為由，誓言要在雅典與埃雷特里亞的廟宇上雪恨；他的使節挨城邦拒絕，於是前四九二年先派女婿馬鐸尼斯打通色雷斯與馬其頓，前四九〇年再派達提斯與阿塔佛涅斯橫渡愛琴海。薛西斯一世繼承父志，前四八〇年以空前規模的陸軍、海軍與赫爾斯蓬特的浮橋親征。希臘方面的關鍵人物是米太亞德，這位受波斯資助、色雷斯出身的指揮官在馬拉松以重裝步兵封住平原兩端，逼波斯軍登船而取勝，卻在戰後被控叛國，死於獄中；雅典的戰略重心則由地米斯托克利轉向海軍，他在勞里安銀礦的收益下推動建造三列槳座戰船，前四八二年因陶片放逐被逐，前四八〇年又回來力主在薩拉米斯海峽迎戰，擊潰波斯艦隊。斯巴達王列奧尼達在溫泉關以三百人與數千盟軍拖住波斯大軍，最後與底比斯部隊一同陣亡；普拉提亞的指揮官帕薩尼阿斯隨後率聯軍取勝。埃斐索的阿里斯塔格拉斯與米利都的希斯提亞斯是起義的推手；斯巴達的德馬拉圖斯叛投波斯並充當御前顧問；波斯方面，馬鐸尼斯、阿爾塔巴祖斯、邁加比佐斯與不死軍的指揮官先後獨當一面。
peopleEn: Darius I was the man who set the war in motion. Taking the burning of Sardis as his pretext, he swore to revenge himself on the temples of Athens and Eretria; when his envoys were driven out by the city-states, he first sent his son-in-law Mardonius in 492 BC to open the way through Thrace and Macedon, and in 490 BC dispatched Datis and Artaphernes to cross the Aegean. Xerxes I inherited the war and in 480 BC invaded in person with an army and navy of unprecedented size, crossing the Hellespont on pontoon bridges. The decisive figure on the Greek side was Miltiades, a commander of Thracian origin raised and paid by the Persians who at Marathon shut the two ends of the plain with his hoplites and forced the Persian army back to its ships, though he was afterwards charged with treason and died in prison. The centre of Athenian strategy then shifted to the navy under Themistocles, who used the revenue of the new silver at Laurium to push the building of triremes, was ostracised in 482 BC, and returned in 480 to argue for meeting the Persians inside the straits of Salamis, where the Persian fleet was destroyed. The Spartan king Leonidas held Thermopylae with three hundred men and several thousand allies and was killed with the Thebans; the commander at Plataea, Pausanias, led the coalition to victory afterwards. Aristagoras of Ephesus and Histiaeus of Miletus were the men who drove the revolt, and the Spartan Demaratus defected to Persia and became an adviser at court. On the Persian side Mardonius, Artabazus, Megabazus and the commanders of the Immortals each took charge of operations in turn.
kits: 卡面這件希臘重裝步兵是整場波希戰爭中最具決定性的裝備，戰役全程都看得到它。其核心是一面直徑約九十公分的圓盾，盾面包銅，握把設在左側，盾牌彼此相接便形成互相遮蔽的盾牆；再配頭盔（科林斯式或雅典式，帶頰甲與頸甲）、護脛、青銅或亞麻胸甲，手執約二點四公尺的長矛與短劍。整套裝備需自備，價值約二百六十德拉克馬，是城邦公民兵的經濟門檻。陣形上，馬拉松的方陣排成八列縱深，前排跪地以盾頂住後排的推力，抵住波斯弓手的連續射擊與長矛衝撞；溫泉關的狹隘地形則讓重裝步兵以數百人擋住數萬大軍。波斯軍的裝備體系完全不同：士兵多持柳條或皮製圓盾，著魚鱗狀鱗甲或軟甲，配短矛、鐮刀斧與可射百五十步的複合弓，另有大量騎兵、戰車與專司破壞的鐮刀戰車，以及以長槍大盾作戰的萬人不死軍。希臘方面的輔助兵器包括弓箭手、標槍手、投石手與攻城用撞槌；雙方都靠糧道、渡河點與船隊維持遠距補給，馬拉松與普拉提亞之間的往返行軍，正是靠各自背後的補給線在支撐。
kitsEn: The Greek hoplite on the card was the single most decisive piece of equipment in the whole of the Persian Wars, and it is visible throughout the campaigns. Its core is a round shield, the aspis, about ninety centimetres across, faced with bronze and gripped on the left arm, so that when the shields are set side by side they make a wall in which each man covers the next. This was worn with a helmet of Corinthian or Attic type with cheek pieces and a neck guard, greaves, a bronze or linen corselet, and carried a long spear of about two and a half metres together with a short sword. The whole set was bought by the soldier himself and was worth about two hundred and sixty drachmas, which was the economic threshold of the citizen soldier. In formation, the phalanx at Marathon was eight ranks deep, the front rank kneeling and bracing its shields against the pressure of the ranks behind, so that the continuous shooting and spear-thrust of the Persians could not open it; at Thermopylae the narrowness of the ground allowed a few hundred hoplites to hold back tens of thousands. The Persian equipment system was entirely different: soldiers carried wicker or leather-covered round shields, wore scaled corselets of overlapping plates or soft armour, and used short spears, pick-axes and composite bows that shot a hundred and fifty paces, with large numbers of horsemen, chariots and scythed chariots built for breaking up enemy formations, as well as the Ten Thousand Immortals fighting with long spears and large shields. The Greek auxiliary arms included archers, javelin-throwers, slingers and ram-battering engines; and both sides ran their far-flung campaigns on grain, river crossings and shipping, with the supply lines behind Marathon and behind Plataea carrying the armies on their long marches.
tactics: 馬拉松的取勝是正面衝鋒的樣板：米太亞德把方陣排成八列縱深，只在兩翼加厚，令波斯弓手無法拉開距離；波斯軍在平原中央被壓住，兩翼向海邊退卻時被方陣切斷，退路又被泊在岸邊的戰船封住，陣形一亂便整片崩潰。波斯人的戰術則是萬箭齊發、以騎兵與戰車反覆衝擊方陣側面，再退回合船隊。溫泉關是另一套打法：聯軍在福基斯舊牆後列陣，波斯軍輪番攻擊，前三日寸步未進；繞到山背的波斯部隊與迂迴的福基斯兵在守軍身後夾擊列奧尼達，最終守軍全滅。薩拉米斯是一場誘敵入峽的殲滅戰：地米斯托克利以假消息引波斯分艦隊進入狹窄海峽，希臘戰船列於兩岸，堤岸與船舷夾住敵船，波斯人無法施展人數優勢；希臘靠船首撞角與划槳紀律取勝。普拉提亞則是步兵會戰的典範：左翼的雅典重裝步兵在陣前拋下長矛，改用短劍衝鋒，把波斯騎兵衝散；斯巴達人、底比斯人與波斯精兵纏鬥處的消耗戰，說明方陣的縱深、翼側的加厚與正面衝撞必須同時運用。
tacticsEn: Marathon was the model of the frontal charge: Miltiades drew his phalanx eight ranks deep, thickened only the wings, and so denied the Persian archers any room to open their range; the Persian centre was pinned in the middle of the plain, and when the wings fell back towards the sea they were cut off by the phalanx and their retreat blocked by the war galleys lying off the shore, and the whole formation came apart. The Persian method was massed arrow-flights, repeated charges by horse and chariot against the flanks of the phalanx, and a withdrawal back to the fleet. Thermopylae was a different business altogether: the allies stood behind the old Phocian wall and the Persians attacked in relays for three days without gaining a step; Persian columns that went round by the mountain and the Phocians who came down the track caught Leonidas from behind and the defenders were destroyed to the last. Salamis was a battle of bait and annihilation: Themistocles sent false news to draw a part of the Persian fleet into the narrows, the Greek ships were disposed on both sides, and the banks and the enemy hulls pinched the Persian ships so that their numbers told for nothing; the Greeks won on the ram and on the discipline of the oarsmen. Plataea was the archetype of the pitched infantry battle: the Athenian hoplites on the left wing threw down their long spears and charged with the short sword, scattering the Persian horse, while the grinding struggle of the Spartans, the Thebans and the Persian picked troops showed that depth of formation, strengthening of the wings and the shock of the frontal charge all had to be used at once.
data: 可引用的數字多出於希羅多德，需知其中修辭成分甚重。馬拉松方面，希臘一側有一萬名重裝步兵的說法，希羅多德記八千；波斯軍被記為十萬步兵、一萬騎兵；陣亡波斯六千四百人、雅典一百九十二人，這是希臘方面保存下來最精確的一組傷亡數。薛西斯的陸軍，希羅多德記為五百二十八萬三千人，現代學界多主張遠少於此，普遍估計在二十萬上下；波斯戰艦數記為一千二百零七艘，進入愛琴海者或不足六百艘。溫泉關聯軍，希羅多德記斯巴達三百、塞斯庇亞七百、底比斯四百、希洛人若干，另有福基斯人一千守在山上，中文資料另記盟軍六千；波斯方面的損失，各家記載自數萬至二十萬不等。薩拉米斯海戰希臘出動三百七十八艘戰船，其中雅典占二百艘；波斯艦隊折損過半。普拉提亞之戰，希臘聯軍總數被記為近七萬，波斯軍則有八十萬至百六十萬的誇大之數。前四九九年愛奧尼亞起義的開始月份在傳世記載中沒有明文，學界依阿耳忒彌斯祭典的日子推算，多定在前四九九年春季，較常引用的是四月。
dataEn: The figures that can be quoted come mostly from Herodotus, whose rhetoric is a heavy discount on them. For Marathon, the Greek side is given as ten thousand hoplites, with Herodotus saying eight thousand; the Persian army is given as a hundred thousand foot and ten thousand horse; and the dead are reckoned at six thousand four hundred Persians against a hundred and ninety-two Athenians, the most precise set of casualty figures the Greek side has preserved. For Xerxes' army Herodotus gives five million two hundred and eighty-three thousand men; modern scholarship holds that this is far too high and commonly puts the real figure at around two hundred thousand. The Persian fleet is given as one thousand two hundred and seven warships, of which perhaps fewer than six hundred entered the Aegean. At Thermopylae, Herodotus counts three hundred Spartans, seven hundred Thespians, four hundred Thebans and a number of helots, with a thousand Phocians posted on the mountain, while other accounts give six thousand allies; the Persian losses are given by different writers as ranging from tens of thousands to two hundred thousand. At Salamis the Greeks put three hundred and seventy-eight ships into the water, of which two hundred were Athenian, and the Persian fleet lost more than half its strength. At Plataea the Greek coalition is put at close to seventy thousand, while the Persian army is inflated to figures of eight hundred thousand or even one million six hundred thousand. The month in which the Ionian Revolt opened in 499 BC is not stated in the transmitted records; on the strength of the date of the festival of Artemis most scholars place the outbreak in the spring of 499 BC, and April is the month usually cited.
cause: 愛奧尼亞的希臘城邦自居魯士大帝於前五四七年征服以來，一直不甘受波斯任命的僭主統治。米利都的阿里斯塔格拉斯藉一次對納克索斯的失敗遠征撤職為由，於前四九九年鼓動起義；雅典與埃雷特里亞派兵協助，前四九八年攻入並焚毀波斯在內陸的首府薩第斯，於是一場地方性的反叛變成了帝國的安全問題。鎮壓起義之後，大流士一世把目標改為征服希臘本土，藉口是雅典與埃雷特里亞協助焚毀薩第斯；此舉同時可看作是要把帝國邊界從愛奧尼亞推到赫爾斯滂地峽，切斷小亞細亞城邦與母邦的聯繫，並懲罰已經證明會干預的希臘城邦。前四九二年馬鐸尼斯的遠征打通色雷斯與馬其頓，正是一次試探；前四九一年大流士又派使節到各城邦索取水土，作為臣服的象徵，雅典與斯巴達殺使，於是全面入侵再無退路。第二次入侵的直接背景還包括埃及與巴比倫的叛亂、薛西斯在位近四年的軍備籌措，以及亞索斯山的運河與赫爾斯滂的浮橋這樣前所未有的工程能力。
causeEn: The Greek cities of Ionia had never accepted the tyrants appointed over them by Persia since Cyrus the Great conquered the region in 547 BC. Aristagoras of Miletus used a failed expedition against Naxos and his own removal from office as the pretext to raise a revolt in 499 BC; Athens and Eretria sent troops to help, and in 498 BC the rebels stormed and burned Sardis, the Persian capital inland, and a local rising became a question of imperial security. After the revolt was crushed, Darius I changed his objective to the conquest of the Greek mainland, with the burning of Sardis and the help given by Athens and Eretria as his stated pretext; the move also had the effect of pushing the frontier of the empire from Ionia to the Hellespont, cutting the cities of Asia Minor off from their mother cities, and punishing the Greek states that had proved capable of interfering. The expedition of Mardonius in 492 BC, which opened Thrace and Macedon, was a probe; in 491 BC Darius sent envoys to the cities to demand earth and water as a sign of submission, and Athens and Sparta killed the envoys, after which there was no turning back from a full invasion. The immediate background to the second invasion included the revolts in Egypt and Babylonia, four years of Xerxes' own arming and preparation, and engineering works on a scale never seen before, such as the cutting of the channel at Mount Athos and the pontoon bridges over the Hellespont.
impact: 這場戰爭的後果遠超戰役本身。希臘方面，雅典從一個中等城邦變成愛琴海的強權：前四七八年成立提洛同盟，前四五四年把同盟金庫從提洛島搬到雅典衛城，戰爭債務、波斯繳金與盟邦船費撐起了雅典的艦隊與公共工程，帕德嫩神廟便是這段錢的產物；民主政治也在戰後加速，前四八二年那次著名的陶片放逐把戰略爭議交給公民投票，重裝步兵的裝備費後來被列為擔任公職的財產資格。斯巴達贏得榮譽與否決權，卻在戰後與伯羅奔尼撒盟邦的爭執中逐漸失勢。波斯方面，帝國並未被削弱，反而在亞洲重新鞏固：塞浦路斯與埃及被平定，愛奧尼亞城邦被重新置於總督之下，島嶼的部分居民被清空，赫爾斯滂浮橋與亞索斯運河把帝國心臟與前線連成一體，希臘則被推成帝國的西部邊界。文化上，希羅多德的《歷史》成為西方敘事史的樣板，溫泉關的墓碑與德爾斐的蛇柱則成為後世不斷重寫的政治符號。
impactEn: The consequences of this war reached far beyond the battlefields. On the Greek side Athens went from a middling city-state to a power in the Aegean: the Delian League was formed in 478 BC, its treasury was moved from the island of Delos to the Athenian Acropolis in 454 BC, and the war debt, the Persian tribute and the ship contributions of the allies paid for the Athenian fleet and for the public works of which the Parthenon is the most famous product. Democracy also advanced after the war: the celebrated ostracism of 482 BC put the question of strategy to a vote of the citizens, and the equipment cost of a hoplite was later written into the property qualification for public office. Sparta gained the prize and the right of veto, but gradually lost ground in the quarrels with the Peloponnesian allies that followed the war. On the Persian side the empire was not weakened but reconfirmed in Asia: Cyprus and Egypt were subdued, the Ionian cities were put back under their satraps, the populations of some islands were expelled, and the Hellespont bridges and the channel at Athos tied the heart of the empire to its frontier, with Greece pushed back to serve as the western border of the empire. In the field of culture Herodotus' Histories became the model for narrative history in the West, and the tombs at Thermopylae and the serpent column at Delphi became political symbols that later ages have rewritten again and again.
result: 分戰役看，結果是希臘在關鍵三戰中取勝：馬拉松的重裝步兵正面擊退波斯大軍，薩拉米斯的希臘艦隊在海峽中毀掉波斯海軍過半，普拉提亞的聯軍在野戰中打散波斯陸軍主力，隨後米卡勒的兩面夾擊把波斯殘部趕回小亞細亞；唯一的敗仗是溫泉關，希臘聯軍全滅，但那場戰鬥的戰略目的——拖延到薩拉米斯——已經達成。戰爭的直接結果是前四七九年築起的科林斯地峽壁壘，之後前四七八年提洛同盟成立、波斯軍被逐出歐洲；前四六六年歐里梅敦之役後同盟軍解放愛奧尼亞全境，波斯在歐洲的據點只剩赫爾斯滂東岸。全面和平要等到前四四九年卡里阿斯和約：雅典與波斯簽約，波斯承諾撤出亞洲城邦、容許愛奧尼亞自治，雅典則承認現狀、與波斯在小亞細亞共享影響力。前四五四年提洛同盟因埃及遠征破產而解散，但提洛同盟的運作、雅典的海上帝國與城邦公民兵的傳統，都從這場戰爭裡定型。
resultEn: Taken battle by battle, the result was a Greek victory in the three battles that mattered: at Marathon the hoplites turned back a Persian army frontally; at Salamis the Greek fleet destroyed more than half the Persian navy inside the straits; at Plataea the coalition broke the main body of the Persian army in the open field, and the two-pronged attack at Mycale then drove the Persian remnants back into Asia Minor. The only defeat was Thermopylae, where the Greek force was destroyed to the last man, but the strategic purpose of that battle, to hold the Persians until Salamis, had been achieved. The direct result of the war was the wall across the Isthmus of Corinth built in 479 BC, followed in 478 BC by the founding of the Delian League and the expulsion of the Persian army from Europe; after the battle of Eurymedon in 466 BC the allies freed all Ionia, and the only Persian foothold left in Europe was the eastern shore of the Hellespont. A general peace had to wait until the Peace of Callias in 449 BC: Athens and Persia concluded a treaty by which Persia undertook to withdraw from the Asian cities and allow Ionia a measure of autonomy, while Athens accepted the existing state of affairs and shared influence over Asia Minor with Persia. The Delian League collapsed in 454 BC after the ruin of the Egyptian expedition, but the working of the league, the Athenian maritime empire and the tradition of the citizen soldier were all fixed in the mould of this war.
